home_intro: Open the check-in activity in your Moodle course on your phone and tap "{button}". At the event, scan the code at the door with that phone.
login_passkey_failed: That passkey did not work. Use your password instead.
admin_initial_password_hint: Pass it on to them. They have to replace it when they first sign in.
admin_reset_hint: Signs them out everywhere. They have to replace it when they next sign in.
admin_temporary_password_too_short: The temporary password needs at least {min} characters.
admin_promote_not_found: No guest has {email} yet. They have to open the check-in activity in Moodle once first.
admin_reset_not_organizer: {email} is not an organizer whose password you can reset.
admin_reset_done: {email} is signed out and has to replace that password on their next sign-in.
change_password_temporary_text: Your password was set by someone else. Replace it before you go on.
change_password_text: This signs you out on every other device.
change_password_same_as_temporary: Choose a password other than the one you were given.
checkins_host_hint: Checked in automatically: a guest got in through the check-in code this admin was showing
checkins_shared_hint: More than one guest checked in from this address
checkins_again_hint: This guest had already checked in earlier
checkins_footnote: Neither flag is wrong on its own — guests step out and come back, and a whole table shares one hotspot. A code that leaked looks like many guests on one address who never passed the desk.
qr_keep_open: This code changes automatically — leave this page open.
passkey_text: Faster than your password, and it can't be phished. Your password keeps working either way.
passkey_failed: That did not work. You can skip for now and try again later.
checkin_scan_heading: Scan the code at the door
checkin_scan_text: This page opens when you scan the QR code on the check-in screen. The code changes every 30 seconds, so scan the one showing now.
checkin_set_up_text: Open the check-in activity in your Moodle course on this phone and tap "{button}". Then scan the code again.
checkin_with_passkey: Organizer? Check in with your passkey
checkin_expired: This code has expired. Scan the one showing on the screen.
checkin_not_confirmed: We could not confirm that was you. Try again.
checkin_not_set_up: This phone isn't set up for check-in. Open the check-in activity in Moodle on this phone, set it up, then scan again.
enroll_open_from_moodle_text: Open the check-in activity in your Moodle course. It sends you here, ready to set up this phone.
enroll_done_text: At the event, scan the code at the door with this phone's camera and you're checked in. You won't need Moodle again.
enroll_done_note: It only works in this browser. Clearing its website data, or setting up another phone, undoes it — then open the Moodle activity again.
enroll_embedded_text: Moodle opened this inside its own page, where your browser won't keep what check-in needs. Continue in a tab of its own.
enroll_intro_phone: Use the phone you'll bring to the event.
enroll_intro_browser: Set it up in the browser that opens when you scan a QR code (usually Safari on an iPhone, Chrome on Android). After that, scanning the code at the door is all it takes.
enroll_already_set_up: This browser is already set up. Doing it again is harmless and replaces the old key.
enroll_key_create_failed: This browser couldn't create a key. Make sure you're not in a private window, and try again.
enroll_key_save_failed: This browser wouldn't save the key. Make sure you're not in a private window, and try again.
enroll_problem_no_profile: Moodle didn't tell us your name and email address, which we need to set you up. Let the organizers know: the activity's privacy settings in Moodle need to share both.
enroll_problem_email_taken: Your email address already belongs to another account here, for example an organizer's. Organizers check in with their passkey. Anyone else: let the organizers know.
enroll_expired: This setup link has expired or was already used. Open the check-in activity in Moodle again.
enroll_bad_key: Something went wrong creating the key. Try again.
